gizmo.title: Crossword
gizmo.description: Crossword laga sameeyay liis erayo iyo tilmaamo. Shabakadda adiga ayaa laguu samaynayaa; ardaydu waxay qoraan erayada oo hubiyaan.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Cinwaanka ama su'aasha ka muuqda crossword-ka korkiisa.

configure.title: Erayada
configure.description: Erey kasta iyo tilmaantiisa. Shabakadda waxaa laga sameeyaa liiskan: ereyga ugu dheer ayaa marka hore la dhigaa, kuwa kalena waxay ka gudbaan xarfaha la wadaago.

advanced.title: Isku dayada
advanced.description: Immisa jeer ayuu ardaygu hubin karaa. 0 macnaheedu waa xad la'aan.

advanced.title: Midabka xoojinta
advanced.description: Midab ikhtiyaari ah oo loogu talagalay chip-ka madaxa, ereyga firfircoon iyo badhamada ficilka.

advanced.title: La isku duubi karo
advanced.description: U muuji crossword-kan sida saf la furo oo la xiro. Furitaanka mid wuxuu xiraa su'aalaha kale ee la isku duubi karo ee agtiisa ah.

advanced.title: Ku bilow isagoo duuban
advanced.description: Marka la isku duubi karo, ku bilow saf xiran oo muujiya cinwaanka iyo xaaladdiisa oo keliya.

advanced.title: Qaabka qiimaynta
advanced.description: OER Schema: qaabka qiimaynta ee qiimayntan (tusaale dhibco, xaraf, boqolley, dhammaystir).

advanced.title: Ujeeddada waxbarasho
advanced.description: OER Schema: ujeeddada waxbarasho ee la xiriirta qiimayntan.

developer.title: Magaca kedisada
developer.description: Magaca kedisada loo isticmaalo aqoonsiga xAPI ee nidaamyada falanqaynta.

developer.title: Koorso
developer.description: OER Schema: koorsada qiimayntan loogu talagalay.
